name: Car engine bay
scene: The front of a car raised on ramps (ramps under the front tyres) so its underside is visible, hood propped open: front bumper with a grille and two headlights (glass), fenders with the front wheels (torus tyres, rims) in their arches, radiator support at the front, the engine in the middle (block, valve cover on top with the oil fill cap, dipstick with a yellow loop, oil filter on the front low down, oil pan underneath with the drain plug), battery on one side, air filter box, washer fluid reservoir with a blue cap, coolant overflow tank, brake fluid reservoir at the back by the firewall. Only the front 1.3 m of the car. No splash shield or lower bumper under the engine, so a low camera in front sees the oil pan, drain plug and filter between the front wheels.
size: Car 1.75-1.85 m wide; bay about 1.4 m wide and 0.9 m deep; on ramps the fender top is at 1.05-1.15 m, engine top about 1.0 m, oil pan bottom about 0.42 m above the floor and the bumper bottom about 0.5 m.

parts.label: Hood
parts.describe: Painted hood hinged at the back edge by the windshield, propped open on a rod.

parts.label: Engine
parts.describe: Engine block (cast_iron) with a moulded valve cover on top (rounded_box, black or silver, with a brand label and ribs via repeat), intake runners (hoses) at the back, belt and pulleys (torus and cylinders) on one side, coil packs or plug wires on top.

parts.label: Oil fill cap
parts.describe: Round cap on the valve cover marked with an oil can; unscrews counter-clockwise and lifts off.

parts.label: Dipstick
parts.describe: Bright yellow or orange loop handle on a long rod in a tube on the front of the engine; pulls straight up and out.

parts.label: Oil filter
parts.describe: Cylindrical canister (blue, orange, black or white) on the side or bottom of the engine; twists off counter-clockwise.

parts.label: Drain plug
parts.describe: Hex bolt in the low point of the oil pan underneath the engine, reached from below; unscrews downward.

parts.label: Oil pan
parts.describe: Pressed steel pan bolted under the engine; the drain plug is its child.

parts.label: Old oil
parts.describe: Dark oil draining into a drain pan on the floor (oil patch or a hose stream).

parts.label: Battery
parts.describe: Black box with red (+) and black (-) terminals and cable clamps, held by a bracket, usually front left or right.

parts.label: Negative terminal
parts.describe: Black cable clamp on the - post; lifts off when its nut is loose.

parts.label: Positive terminal
parts.describe: Red cable clamp on the + post, often with a red cover.

parts.label: Corrosion
parts.describe: White-green crust on a battery post (mineral_scale clump).

parts.label: Washer fluid cap
parts.describe: Blue (or black) flip or twist cap with a windshield symbol on a translucent reservoir near the front corner.

parts.label: Air filter box lid
parts.describe: Black plastic box with a clipped lid on the intake; the lid lifts up after unclipping.

parts.label: Air filter
parts.describe: Rectangular pleated panel filter in the box; lifts straight out.

parts.label: Coolant cap
parts.describe: Pressure cap on the coolant overflow tank (never open when hot).

parts.label: Brake fluid cap
parts.describe: Small cap on the brake fluid reservoir at the firewall.

debris: old oil draining into a drain pan
dirt in the air filter (grime patch, child of the filter)
an oil drip patch on the floor
views: front, high, looking down into the bay
front-right and low for the oil filter and drain plug
notes: Keep the car body hollow (fender and bumper shells) so the bay is visible from above, and keep the space under the engine clear between the wheels. Put an oil drain pan (lathe) on the floor under the plug.
